completedCapabilities: Fresh installations consistently default to MySQL schema CCMA and application user ccma; Compose uses an authenticated database healthcheck, manual unique-index migration is restart-idempotent, and external pricing synchronization is opt-in.

S0 has a versioned synthetic Vietnamese intervention corpus and an empty-development-database baseline; the first S1 slice reports item-level sync failures as partial without advancing the success checkpoint or triggering after-sync analysis.

S1 analysis snapshots: core single/batch snapshot and evidence validation plus cascade/fingerprint and parent-locking repairs are implemented. ResetDemoData now uses an error-checked transaction; snapshot-bound MySQL regressions prove rollback preservation and success-path deletion. Independent Gate B REVIEW passed at commit 20cfa55, but FREEZE remains open. The optional legacy demo fixture branch is not exercised by the current reset tests; engine tests cover legacy result interpretation. Test-double/MySQL evidence is not real-provider governance proof.

CCMAI-RUNTIME-003 REVIEW PASS: a same-external-ID message replay updates changed content/sender/content-type/timestamp and merges attachments by (type, url, name) identity, preserving a stored local path only for a matching identity and never erasing a stored attachment list from an empty reply. Repair round 1 (R003-R1/R003-R2) added raw-data serialization with error checks (an unmarshalable value now returns an error instead of staying silently stale) and canonical-JSON comparison so an unchanged raw-data replay issues no write; the central replay test now also changes and asserts sender role and content type. Codex independently re-reviewed commit 1f290a6 and reran all 8 replay tests and the full backend suite on disposable MySQL CCMA. S1 remains IN_PROGRESS; FREEZE remains open.

CCMAI-RUNTIME-004 repair round 1 (R004-R1/R004-R2/R004-R3): a linked snapshot's own digest, schema, tenant/conversation/job-run identity and message count are now validated before any comparison, so a mismatched or corrupted snapshot reports verification_unavailable rather than a false locally-matching status. Added-earlier-message detection now compares the current earlier-message count against the manifest's recorded omitted count instead of silently ignoring every older message. New handler tests exercise the actual ListResults/ExportResults HTTP handlers, CSV/XLSX label equivalence, cross-tenant snapshot-link isolation, and a forced batch-query failure proving a non-2xx response. All 18 targeted engine tests, 19 targeted handler tests and the full 13-package backend suite pass on disposable MySQL. Status REVIEW_PENDING for Codex's independent re-review; no FREEZE.
knownLimitations: Application runtime CVF controls have not been integrated or tested with a real provider; the revised CSKH roadmap and SoT-first filtering decision remain proposals, including early human review, Vietnamese quality gates and Jev-inspired filtering with downstream LLM. Cross-project reuse and CVF uplift follow CSKH completion. CCMAI-RUNTIME-004's source_integrity_status is a local, informational signal only, bounded to the aggregate Results surface; job-specific/conversation APIs, notifications, automatic re-analysis and upstream edit/delete discovery outside fetch windows remain separately scoped and unimplemented.
